scope: Desktop Lua fake-environment diagnostics cost/resource evidence only. Native WoW CPU, frame time, FPS, memory, taint and random-spike cause are unverified.

baseline.tree: Actual dirty tree preserved by external source.zip; includes preexisting raid work
baseline.watchFeature: ABSENT; no equivalent baseline watch scenario.

candidate.sourceDriftGuard: PASS: candidate and fixture identities unchanged across all25 runs.

host.gameClient: None; isolated child Lua processes, no WoW input or preferences changed.

protocol.offOrder: Baseline/candidate in pairs1,3,5; candidate/baseline in pairs2,4.
protocol.enabledOrder: quiet, slow, gaps in each repetition
protocol.collection: Host Lua collectgarbage collect before measured startup/drive and after stop, outside measured drive; capture sees only mock collectgarbage count, never forces native collection.
protocol.startup: Warmed start after one2000-frame warmup and stop; sole owned frame is reused. Cold first-start creation is not timed.
protocol.timer: Lua os.clock raw per-region milliseconds; Windows CRT semantics are not assumed to establish process CPU. Python perf_counter measures whole child wall; GetProcessTimes separately measures whole child user/kernel CPU including parse, warmup and measured drive.
protocol.callbacks: Slow scenario feeds two synthetic timing notifications per frame (25ms Events,12ms Scheduler), not real work of those durations. Core timing-seam overhead is excluded and must be assessed separately.
protocol.clock: The harness debugprofilestop values and report diagnosticMs are synthetic. syntheticDiagnosticMs is not measured overhead.
protocol.heap: Lua process-global KB before/after drive and post-collection. Heap delta is neither cumulative allocated bytes, addon-specific allocation nor a memory-leak proof.
protocol.baselineComparison: Only dormant behavior has matched baseline/candidate cases. Enabled-watch samples describe new diagnostic overhead/resources, not a baseline optimization or performance improvement.

functionalResourceResult: PASS: dormant cases zero observers/frames/timers/metric reads; enabled cases one reused frame, zero timers and frame enumeration; records and labels bounded; stop detaches and clears label/release caches.
nativeAcceptance: PENDING: these observations identify no native cause and certify no rendering, secure behavior, FPS or freeze removal.
